column1: # Flows of the benchmark apps checked against their decompiled code (JADX 1.5.6), for evaluate.py.
# app (package_versionCode), verdict (real: the map must report it; false: it must not), data, sink,
# sink method (class.method, as the report's sinkIn), source (the report's sourceApi prefix, or * for any),
# why (what the code does). Matching is on data, sink, sink method and source; a real verdict is met by
# any flow of that data into that sink in that method.
